name: IOLBENCH
description: Despite the remarkable advancements and widespread applications of deep neural networks, their ability to perform reasoning tasks remains limited, particularly in domains requiring structured, abstract thought. In this paper, we investigate the linguistic reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) by introducing IOLBENCH, a novel benchmark derived from International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) problems. This dataset encompasses diverse problems testing syntax, morphology, phonology, and semantics, all carefully designed to be self-contained and independent of external knowledge.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for linguistic reasoning from IOL-style problems; it is interesting for reasoning research but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Likely small and highly specialized; performance depends on deep linguistic reasoning rather than external knowledge, and benchmark size may limit statistical stability.
